Web shop design for small businesses

A web shop that loads fast, works well on a phone and lets you manage your own products, stock and orders. From €1,950 with up to 50 products already set up for you, ready in 3–5 weeks.

What's included

  • Up to 50 products set up, with the photos and texts you supply
  • Online payments with the payment methods your customers use
  • Shipping costs set up
  • Fast and mobile-friendly
  • You manage your own products, stock and orders

Running costs

A domain name usually costs about €10 to €25 a year. The shop platform and the payment provider charge their own fees; we list them in your quote so there are no surprises. Maintenance is optional from €29 a month.

Get a free quote

How it works

  1. Tell us by email what you sell and to whom.
  2. You get a free concept of the homepage and a product page, designed for your shop.
  3. After you approve, we build the shop and set up payments and shipping.
  4. You test everything yourself, then the shop goes live.

What a shop can look like

An example of a complete web shop with basket, checkout and management is Suismuis Home, a shop for home accessories. It is a concept version and has not launched yet. Our own apps and games are on the projects page.

Frequently asked questions

Can I add more products later?

Yes, you do that yourself in the admin, without technical knowledge. There is no limit on what you add later. At delivery we show you how to change products, photos, prices and stock. With the package we already set up your first 50 products, so your shop is ready to sell from day one.

Do I own the web shop?

Yes. The shop, the domain and the content are registered in your name, as are your customer and order data. You are not tied to us: if you later want to work with someone else, you take everything with you.

What does "from €1,950" mean?

It is the price of the package described here: a shop with up to 50 products, payments and shipping. If you need more, for example a special integration, you get a fixed price up front. All prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added.

Do you build shops for businesses outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch, and set up the payment methods and shipping options that fit your country. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere. The payment provider's transaction fees are listed in the quote up front.
